projection_lead: Illustrative weight change when treatment is combined with clinical support.
projection_disclaimer: Illustrative projection only. Actual outcomes vary by treatment, dose, adherence and individual health factors.
proj_footnote: Based on outcomes data from patients using GLP-1 treatments with ongoing clinical support. Illustrative only; individual results vary.
proj_callout_3_body: Early changes show up first in appetite and habits, before the scale catches up.
proj_callout_6_body: Enough time to lose weight steadily, build healthier habits, and see meaningful, lasting change.
proj_callout_12_body: A full year of clinical support, where the change you have made has time to settle into how you live.
proj_missing_title: We need your weight to show this
proj_missing_body: Your projection is built from the weight you enter at the first question. Go back and add it to see it here.
motivation_headline: This is where life starts to change.
motivation_body_1: Medical weight loss changes more than the number on the scale.
motivation_body_2: It shapes how you feel, how you move and how you show up around others.
motivation_stat_1_label: average body weight lost over 68 weeks
motivation_stat_2_label: average body weight lost over 72 weeks
motivation_footnote: Individual results vary. Sources: Wilding et al., NEJM 2021; Jastreboff et al., NEJM 2022.

fail_refused_body: The medical service could not create a checkout for this plan. Nothing has been charged.

fail_unavailable_body: The medical service did not answer, so nothing was ordered and nothing has been charged. Try again in a moment.

meta_home: Personalised, doctor-led weight-loss care designed to help men feel healthier, more confident and supported for the long term.

framing_title: Weight loss isn’t a motivational issue, it’s a medical one.
framing_body: Medicated weight loss isn’t ‘cheating’. Stress, hormones and genetics can all influence your weight. Solean evens the playing field.

qn_email_description: Your answers stay confidential between you and our medical team.
qn_phone_description: Get order updates, exclusive discounts and tips by SMS. Opt out anytime.
qn_side_effects_label: Do you have side effects from your current medication?
qn_side_effects_description_label: Please describe your side effects and how severe they are.
qn_gallbladder_label: Have you had surgery to remove your gallbladder?
qn_mental_health_label: Have you been diagnosed with a mental health condition or had suicidal thoughts?
qn_eating_disorder_label: Do you currently have, or have you ever had, an eating disorder?
qn_eating_disorder_description: Anorexia, bulimia, binge eating or similar. Please select Yes even if it was never medically confirmed.
qn_other_medication_label: Do you take any other medication, including prescription and over-the-counter?
qn_other_medication_description: The medication delays gastric emptying and could affect the absorption of oral medication taken at the same time.
qn_other_medication_details_label: Please give details of the other medication.
qn_other_medication_details_description: Name / dose (e.g. 25 mg) / how often you take it (e.g. 1 tablet a day)
qn_disclaimer_label: Please read the following and confirm that you have understood it.
qn_disclaimer_points:
I confirm that I tried diet and exercise before taking medication.
I will read the package leaflet and Solean's doctor's letter, and consult my doctor if I have concerns.
I will find out how to store the medication and how to dispose of the needles.
The treatment is for my personal use only.
My answers are accurate and truthful.
I am aware of the risks of the treatment.
I understand that regular medical check-ups are necessary.
If my mood changes I will seek medical help immediately.
I am aware that the medication can affect my ability to drive and my tolerance of alcohol.
qn_contraception_description: Mounjaro can reduce the effectiveness of oral hormonal contraceptives. If you take an oral contraceptive pill, you must use a barrier method (a condom, for example) during the first 4 weeks of treatment and for 4 weeks after every dose increase.
qn_weight_related_label: Have you been diagnosed with any of the following?
qn_wrc_heart: Heart disease or peripheral vascular disease, including angina, previous heart attacks, previous stroke
qn_diseases_label: Do you have any of the following conditions?
qn_dis_insulin: Use of insulin (Actrapid or Humulin, for example) or diabetes medication such as sulfonylureas (gliclazide, glibenclamide, tolbutamide, glipizide, glimepiride)
qn_dis_weight_surgery: Weight loss surgery in the last 3 months
qn_dis_ibd: Inflammatory stomach or bowel disease (Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis, for example)
qn_family_diseases_label: Have you or a family member ever had any of the following?
qn_allergies_label: Are you allergic to any substances, medications or foods?
qn_eating_statements_label: Do any of these statements apply to you?
qn_eat_vomit: I have made myself vomit after feeling uncomfortably full
qn_eat_control: I worry about losing control over how much I eat
qn_eat_lost_6kg: I have lost more than 6 kg in the past 3 months
qn_eat_body_image: I believe I am fat even when others say I am too thin
qn_eat_dominated: My life is dominated by food
qn_pregnancy_label: Are you pregnant, breastfeeding, or planning a pregnancy?
qn_preg_planning: I am planning a pregnancy in the next 2 months
qn_past_medication_label: Are you already being treated for excess weight and/or type 2 diabetes?
qn_past_medication_description: With Wegovy, Saxenda or Mounjaro, for example.
qn_med_never: No, I am not taking any of these
